name: rockbuilt
description: Installs and updates the Rockbuilt harness in a project repo (vendored, so cloud routines, Cursor and Codex see it too): EARS specs, verifiable tasks, planner, implementer, verifier and blind auditor separation, autonomy tiers with a mechanical floor, a code-enforced merge gate, and a nightly cycle that escalates to the human only for design, cost and sensitive changes.
